items.title: Bitcoin price fails to break higher after best weekly close in eight months
items.description: Bitcoin’s highest weekly close in eight months formed low-timeframe resistance at the start of Monday’s US trading session.

items.title: Strive adds 2,000 bitcoin in biggest buy since June, closes in on MARA
items.description: Strive’s bitcoin holdings near 30,000 BTC as the race among the largest public treasuries heats up.
